questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The Central Board of Secondary Education has launched a new helpline for students.

options.text: A new helpline for students will be launched by the Central Board of Secondary Education.
A new helpline for students had been launched by the Central Board of Secondary Education.
A new helpline for students has been launched by the Central Board of Secondary Education.
A new helpline for students is launched by the Central Board of Secondary Education.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**A new helpline for students has been launched by the Central Board of Secondary Education**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present perfect tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject ''**The Central Board of Secondary Education**'' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''**a new helpline for students**'' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "**has +** V3 (launched)" should be converted into the passive format "has + been + V3 (launched)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present perfect tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 TENSE
 ACTIVE
 PASSIVE
 PASSIVE CONVERSION
 
 

 Present Simple
 He plays football
 am/is/are + V3
 Football is played by him
 
 

 Present Continuous
 He is playing football
 am/is/are + being +V3
 Football is being played by him
 
 

 Present Perfect
 He has played football
 Has/have + been+ V3
 Football has been played by him
 
 

 Present Perfect Continuous
 He has been playing football
 Not used and unusual.
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Past Simple
 He played football
 Was/were + V3
 Football was played by him
 
 

 Past Continuous
 He was playing football
 Was/were + being + V3
 Football was being played by him
 
 

 Past Perfect

 Had + been + V3
 Football had been played by him
 
 

 Past Perfect Continuous
 He had been playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Future Simple
 He will play football
 Will + be + V3
 Football will be played by him
 
 

 Future Continuous
 He will be playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Future Perfect
 He will have played football
 Will have been + V3
 Football will have been played by him
 
 

 Future Perfect Continuous
 He will have been playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual

 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह present perfect tense में है।
 
• जब हम इस वाक्य को passive voice में बदलते हैं, तो active voice का subject 'The Central Board of Secondary Education', object बन जाता है और object 'a new helpline for students', subject बन जाता है।
 
• Active format "has + V3 (launched)" को passive format "has + been + V3 (launched)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यह present perfect tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anju said to Vijaya, "You can stay with us whenever you are in Delhi."

options.text: Anju told Vijaya that she could stay with them whenever she was in Delhi
Anju told Vijaya that you can stay with us whenever you are in Delhi
Anju told Vijaya that she can stay with us whenever she is in Delhi
Anju told Vijaya that she could stay with them whenever you were in Delhi

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Anju told Vijaya that she could stay with them whenever she was in Delhi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added, also, ''**said to**'' becomes '**told**'.
 
• The second-person pronoun 'You' becomes the third-person pronoun 'she' and the first-person pronoun 'us' becomes the third-person pronoun '**them**'. 
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (can) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (could) + Object'.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (are) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.**
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas हटा दिए जाते हैं और 'that' जोड़ा जाता है और 'said to', 'told' बन जाता है।
 
• The second-person pronoun 'You', third-person pronoun 'she' बन जाता है और the first-person pronoun 'us**', the third-person pronoun 'them' बन जाता है।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (can) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (could) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (are) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

• The subject '**mother**' in the sentence is **singular** and **will always take a** **singular verb**.
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'reads' should be used in place of the plural form 'read'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: ***My mother generally reads** the local newspaper to keep abreast of the local news*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Thus, if a subject is singular, its verb must also be singular; if the subject is plural, its verb must also be plural. (इस प्रकार, यदि कोई विषय एकवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए ; यदि विषय बहुवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी बहुवचन होनी चाहिए)

questions.question:

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the **verb 'would'** is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is the first conditional sentence expressing a situation in which the outcome is likely to happen in the future. 
 
• When using the first conditional we use the simple present tense in the if-clause and simple future tense in the main clause.
 
• The format is: **if + present simple, ... will + infinitive **(here,** miss**).
 
• Therefore, the simple future tense 'will' should be used in place of 'would'.
 
• Also, the adverb 'surely' should be used in place of 'sure'.
 
• The adverb 'surely' means **without a doubt**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *If he doesn't reach the station in time, he **will surely miss**** the train*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में **'would' क्रिया** का प्रयोग **गलत है**।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य first conditional sentence है जो उस स्थिति को व्यक्त करता है जिसमें परिणाम भविष्य में होने की संभावना है।
 
• First conditional sentence का उपयोग करते समय हम if-क्लॉज में simple present tense और main clause में simple future tense का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
 
• प्रारूप है: if + present simple, ... will + infinitive (यहाँ, miss)।
 
• अतः 'would' के स्थान पर simple future tense 'will' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• साथ ही '**sure**' के स्थान पर adverb 'surely' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• Adverb 'surely' का अर्थ है **निस्‍संदेह, बिना किसी संदेह के**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

सही वाक्य: *If he doesn't reach the station in time, he will surely miss** the train*.
